question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guides stepped 7.7 -> 8.5 -> 9.2B across FY27 (+0.7-0.8B/qtr; actuals land ~0.1B under guide). Plain continuation implies ~9.9-10.0B for Q4. But FY27 is a 53-week year with a 14-week Q4 (per 10-Q), and opex is mostly weekly-accruing payroll, so +4-7% on top -> ~10.3-10.6B. CEO transition (Huang resigned Nov 12; Kress interim) adds two-sided uncertainty: conservative guiding vs. retention/transition costs. No human market on opex guidance found (Polymarket has EPS-beat; Kalshi has mention markets only).

calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) whether Q4 FY27 is a 14-week quarter: confirmed via the 10-Q search; (2) whether the CFO's full-year 'low 50s' opex growth is real and current: confirmed, from the Q2 FY27 call (raised from upper forties). Because the full-year outlook already includes the 53rd week, Run 1's extra +4-7% for the 14th week double-counts it; the full-year remainder puts Q4 at ~9.7-10.2B, close to Runs 2 and 3. I lean slightly above them (10.1 vs 9.95-10.0) because guides run above actuals, management raised the full-year number last quarter, and transition costs add upside. Searching for the Q3 release itself found nothing beyond preview articles; it is not out yet.
